messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Wu <procurement@cloudreach-solutions.com>, Andy Cho <andy.cho@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Merchant Onboarding — Procurement & Billing Coordination

Hi Sandra / Andy —

Thanks for taking the time to kick this off. CloudReach is on our GCP Marketplace path and procurement has asked for a short questionnaire + billing mapping so they can approve the listing and issue purchase orders. 

High level ask from your side: can you share the procurement questionnaire and preferred PO/billing fields (cost center, legal entity, billing contact)? We want to deliver a complete packet back in 48-72 hours so you can route to finance.

Internal note: Vanessa — can you lead the intake for the questionnaire? Karthik — please be prepared to map our SKU/billing rows to their cost centers once we have it. Laura — I'll loop you for MSA/terms questions.

Attachments: redwood_mcp_msa_draft.docx (draft MSA for their legal team to review)

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Sandra: send the questionnaire & target approval date
- Redwood (Vanessa): return completed questionnaire + billing mapping in 48-72h
- Redwood (Karthik): prepare SKU to PO mapping
- Parties: confirm DocuSign flow for MSA after procurement greenlight

Thanks — looking to keep this tight so listing timeline doesn't slip.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

Sergio,

Thanks — attaching our standard GCP marketplace procurement questionnaire (crs_gcp_procurement_questionnaire_v3.pdf). A few notes:

- We need (a) line-item SKU pricing mapped to our internal cost centers, (b) the legal billing entity, and (c) a point of contact for tax/exemption forms.
- Ideal timing for our cycle: questionnaire returned within 72 hours so we can include the listing in the next vendor review (target: May 3).
- For MSA: we prefer a redline of your draft if possible; otherwise we can circulate our standard addendum.

Attachment: crs_gcp_procurement_questionnaire_v3.pdf

Sandra Wu
Director, Strategic Procurement
CloudReach Solutions
procurement@cloudreach-solutions.com

We received the questionnaire — thanks. We're on it and will return a fully completed packet by end of day Friday (tomorrow). Quick coordination items:

1) Karthik will lead SKU-to-PO mapping (see cc). Expect a CSV with the following columns: SKU, Description, Unit Price, Redwood Billing Code, CloudReach Cost Center.
2) Laura will coordinate the MSA redline; Sergio, we flagged one term about data retention we may want to call out to CloudReach legal.
3) For tax forms: please confirm which state/entity you need them filed against (CloudReach entity name).

Vanessa Ortiz
